scientific_read.label: MARGINAL
scientific_read.means: Typed fit on cold SE(3)-lite is neither a clean clear nor a clean capacity fail. Two folds clear 0.80 late; one misses by noise-scale margin; late dynamics still unsettled (R_CLIMBING). A harness with clearly adequate capacity for this leaked-label task would likely have cleared early and by a wide margin — not asymptoted toward the bar over hundreds of epochs.
scientific_read.what_G_fit_was_for: One boring yes/no: is the harness structurally sound enough to trust a negative from Arm B.
scientific_read.what_we_overfit_the_check_into: Geometric decay ceilings, ratio-instability diagnosis, epoch-budget modeling — more precision on a marginal result does not turn it into strong evidence either way.
scientific_read.Arm_B: Do not lean hard on Arm B S1/S2 as FAIL_NO_SIGNAL, and do not treat E=200 INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERFIT as decisive underfit either. Lite G_fit never gave a crisp binary.
